content: facts-only real-world references for delay and chorus type NAMES; the catalog has no type rosters so this is name-keyed and cannot drift-check against ordinals
source: Fractal wiki 'Delay block' and 'Chorus block' pages, human-pasted 2026-08-21; facts only, no prose
warning: ordinal mapping requires hardware (issue #5); never assume the wiki's list order matches the enum order

delay_types.Stereo Mind Guy: Deluxe Memory Man (stereo variant of the same reference)
delay_types.2290 W/ Modulation: the 2290 (80s rack digital delay); NOTE: ships with Phase Reverse = Right, silent if summed to mono after the block
delay_types.Zephyr: Fractal Audio original, not based on a real unit
delay_types.Vintage Digital: early primitive 8-bit digital delay (era model, no specific unit named)

chorus_types.MX234 Stereo: MXR M134 Stereo Chorus (per wiki; section/list names disagree upstream)
chorus_types.Japan CE-1 Chorus: Boss CE-1 (pedal version of the Roland JC-120 chorus), chorus mode
chorus_types.Japan CE-2: Boss CE-2 (1979 mono chorus, successor of the CE-1)
chorus_types.Dimension 1: Roland SDD-320 Dimension D (types correspond to the unit's modes)

multitap_types.1210: TC 1210 Spatial Expander / Stereo Chorus Flanger
multitap_types.A.H. Clean Long: Allan Holdsworth's use of the Yamaha UD Stomp
multitap_types.A.H. Clean Short: Allan Holdsworth's use of the Yamaha UD Stomp
multitap_types.A.H. Lead Long: Allan Holdsworth's use of the Yamaha UD Stomp
multitap_types.A.H. Lead Short: Allan Holdsworth's use of the Yamaha UD Stomp
multitap_types.A.H. Swell Long: Allan Holdsworth's use of the Yamaha UD Stomp
multitap_types.A.H. Swell Short: Allan Holdsworth's use of the Yamaha UD Stomp
multitap_types.Aerosol: a chorus preset in the Lexicon MPX 1
multitap_types.Aurora Delay: Keeley HALO Andy Timmons delay pedal (Robert Keeley personally offered insight and a diagram)
multitap_types.Quad Chorus: the Quad Chorus block of previous-generation Fractal hardware
multitap_types.Strange Things: themed on the TV series (not a gear model)
